# `type-narrowed`

Type narrowed

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `error` in requests, `info` in responses |
| **Rule IDs** | `type-narrowed` (both directions), `type-narrowed-in-request`, `type-narrowed-in-response` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M5) |
| **Group** | Schemas ([RULES.md section 7](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

The type now accepts less, e.g. `number` → `integer`.

## Why this default

In requests: clients sending the removed kinds of values are rejected. In responses: clients receive a subset of what they handled.

## Example

From test case [`type-narrowed`](../../test/cases/type-narrowed/): number → integer in a request.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
        properties:
          name:
-           type: number
+           type: integer
```

Findings:

- `type-narrowed-in-request` · error · #/components/schemas/Pet

|---|---|---|
| [`type-narrowed`](../../test/cases/type-narrowed/) | `type-narrowed-in-request` · error · #/components/schemas/Pet | number → integer in a request. |
| [`type-narrowed-union`](../../test/cases/type-narrowed-union/) | `type-narrowed-in-request` · error · #/components/schemas/Pet | A oneOf of an object and a string replaced by an inline object: the union's types are its branches' types, so string was dropped. |

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file, for the generic ID or any variant ID above (the more specific ID wins). See [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  type-narrowed: info
```

## How to fix

In requests, keep accepting the old type.
